Key.English: Selected AI-driven land vehicles drive in a straight line, forward or backward, until the cursor position is abeam of them. Each vehicle picks its own direction from where the cursor falls relative to it; a vehicle the cursor is beside rather than ahead of or behind does not move. Selecting a crew member orders the vehicle he is riding in.
Furthest a vehicle may be ordered to drive in one order, in meters. Orders pointing further away are shortened to this distance rather than refused.
Cursor is not ahead of or behind the vehicle

Least time in seconds a vehicle may spend driving before the order expires. An order longer than this setting can cover is given the time its own distance needs instead, so raising it only affects short orders.
